About this Event

Garam Masala : #1 Desi Dating Show
Sunday December 6, 2026
Showtime 6:30PM, Doors 6PM
Running time 80 minutes

How the Night WorksImagine The Bachelor meets Indian Matchmaking, but live on stage hosted by two comedians who are deeply unqualified and absolutely thriving.
Garam Masala Dating is NYC's #1 live desi dating show where South Asian singles go on a blind date in front of a packed house. Our hosts Surbhi and Wyatt guide the chaos with stand-up, crowd work, and genuine matchmaking instincts. Every show ends with a singles mixer where the audience gets to continue the experiment.
Whether you're South Asian or not, curious, single, coupled up, or just need a story, this is the most fun you'll have watching two people fall in love (or spectacularly not) in real time.
